cards.title: Ilam Tea Gardens
cards.blurb: Rolling hills of manicured tea bushes in Nepal's far east. Ilam's orthodox teas are sold around the world.

cards.title: Kanchenjunga
cards.blurb: At 8,586 m, the third-highest mountain on Earth, straddling the border of Nepal and Sikkim. Its base camp trek is one of the wildest in the country.

cards.title: Koshi Tappu Wildlife Reserve
cards.blurb: Wetlands on the Sapta Koshi floodplain, home to the last wild water buffalo (arna) in Nepal and hundreds of bird species.

cards.title: Antu Danda Sunrise
cards.blurb: The hilltop near the Indian border where the sun climbs out of a sea of cloud over the tea gardens.

cards.title: Pathibhara Devi
cards.blurb: A hilltop shrine above Taplejung at 3,794 m, one of the most important pilgrimage sites in the east.

cards.title: Ilam First-Flush Tea
cards.blurb: A tin of the first spring picking — light, floral, and the pride of the eastern hills.

cards.title: Tea-Picking with the Pickers
cards.blurb: Join the pickers on the slopes at dawn: two leaves and a bud. Roll to fill your basket.

cards.title: Kinema and Tongba
cards.blurb: Fermented soybean curry and hot millet beer sipped through a bamboo straw. Everyone at the table collects.

cards.title: Chhurpi Chewing Contest
cards.blurb: Hard yak-cheese chhurpi can last an hour. Challenge one traveller — highest roll finishes theirs first.
